topSignals.title: Project Jupiter: dismissal motion rejected, Dec 7 air-permit hearing confirmed to proceed — plus a new county "potential breach" notice over the El Paso Electric backup-power plan.
topSignals.text: A wider lookback (not caught by the Oct 28–Nov 2 digests) surfaced two Oct 27 developments on Oracle/Bloom's 2.4 GW SOFC microgrid in Doña Ana County, NM. Hearing Officer James Browning denied New Energy Economy's motion to dismiss the revised air permit, so the Dec 7 hearing stands; the revised application caps operation at 1,600 MW (~65% of the 2.4 GW nameplate) as an "enforceable" condition and raises the fuel-stack height from 30 to 45 feet. Separately, Doña Ana County commissioners voted unanimously to notify the developers of a "potential breach" of the 2025 industrial-revenue-bond agreement, tied to a proposed El Paso Electric backup-power connection (a $100M/10-year payment) that Chair Manny Sanchez said would violate the bond terms unless amended — with a majority vote to amend "might not be achieved." Neither article changes the Dec 7 hearing date; the county matter is unresolved and specifically about the backup-power/utility-connection side of the project, not the fuel-cell plant itself. topSignals.title: Elcogen crosses six and a half weeks quiet (43 days) and Topsoe passes nine and three-quarter weeks (68 days)
topSignals.text: — dedicated English- and German-language searches for both priority stacks today returned only standing factory/manufacturing background, no new press release. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new news-archive item since Sept 21 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 43 days quiet. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset, confirmed via English- and German-language searches today — 68 days quiet; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by PTX/ammonia/SAF/blue-hydrogen news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation — new cycle, round 1 (FuelCell Energy, Mitsubishi Power): no new stack/cell-technology items for either; results were standing Q3 earnings/data-center background (FuelCell Energy) and the standing Takasago 400 kW SOEC test-module background (Mitsubishi Power/MHI).

Tier 2 sweep — "Bloom Energy OR FuelCell Energy OR Ceres Power OR Sunfire OR SolydEra": no new item; results recycled standing background (Ceres/Goldman Sachs upgrade, Cummins-Ceres DOE deal, Bloom backlog/Oracle coverage).

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation — cycle 6, round 3 (Plansee, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN, Chaozhou Three-Circle/CCTC, Delta Electronics, Shell), 7-day lookback: no new items for any of the six. Chaozhou Three-Circle (CCTC) and Ningbo SOFCMAN again returned no company-specific SOFC/SOEC news — continuing open data gap; Delta Electronics and Shell results repeated the standing Ceres-licensing and Ceres/Shell SOEC-demonstrator background.

Tier 3 sweeps — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR Doosan Fuel Cell OR SK ecoplant" and "Watt Fuel Cell OR OxEon Energy OR Nexceris OR Kawasaki Heavy Industries OR Miura OR Weichai": no new item for either; results repeated the standing Sept 18 Doosan-Reverion $78M stack order and the Miura/Ceres Japan CHP launch.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter (NM, installation underway, air-permit hearing confirmed Dec 7, dismissal motion rejected), AEP (1 GW), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B, Vineland NJ — first power block reported ready Oct 22; block capacity undisclosed), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW, PA), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (Icheon/Paju, Korea, 28 MW, operational).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), 75 MW Texas Capacity Reservation Agreement, SDCL (up to 450 MW). No named deployment live yet.

Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B cumulative, mixed SOFC/PAFC); separately supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only (2023-vintage GDS Singapore SOFC deal); no new named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
